program: Wingless raw-input to invariant representation to multi-step reasoning chain
question: Do the context-induced alias classes remain useful when unseen multi-step role programs switch raw surface families across operations, rather than only in one-step cross-family transitions?
hypothesis: Using the exact R2 surface representation, contextual bridge, induced classes, and single-step transition training, the induced-class learner will achieve at least 0.95 accuracy on all frozen three-, five-, and seven-step programs whose operation aliases alternate across families. The exact-surface learner and shuffled-bridge learner will each remain at or below 0.25 overall accuracy.

portfolio_context.reason: stress the newly supported context-induced surface invariance under multi-step composition

prior_evidence.observation: Nine two-member alias classes were recovered correctly; induced same-family and cross-family accuracy were both 1.0, exact-surface cross-family accuracy was 0.03125 with 160 missing transitions, and shuffled-context control accuracy was 0.15.

scope_statement: This is a bounded compositional stress test. Passing establishes that context-induced alias abstraction survives multi-step learned-transition composition on the frozen synthetic role workload; it does not establish open-domain language reasoning.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

training_and_representation.task_training: byte-identical R2 task corpus: two complete surface families, all five operations on all sixteen value pairs, twenty repeats per family
training_and_representation.bridge: byte-identical R2 normal bridge and byte-identical R2 shuffled +2 controls
training_and_representation.surface_representation: byte-identical R2 top-eighteen raw four-byte motif selection
training_and_representation.transition_training: single-step only; no multi-step program is used for training

heldout_programs.conjugated_right: for every ordered semantic value pair and each left-swap start 0..3, evaluate swap_roles -> left_swap_start_k -> swap_roles
heldout_programs.long_program_generation: for every ordered semantic value pair and four frozen seeds per length, use the established deterministic role-program generator
heldout_programs.operation_alias_family: step_index mod 2, so every heldout program contains both operation surface families

learners.induced: R2 context-induced alias classes plus R2 class transition learner; predictions are fed forward through every heldout program step
learners.exact_surface_control: R2 exact-surface transition learner; predicted surface value IDs are fed forward through every step
learners.shuffled_bridge_control: R2 frozen +2 shuffled context classes plus identical class transition learner

controls: All three learners receive identical single-step task training observations.
No multi-step program appears in training.
Every heldout program contains both operation alias families.
Normal and shuffled alias classes are induced before heldout execution and remain frozen.
Evaluator operation semantics generate and score targets only; no prediction path calls evaluator operation code.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, capacity growth, oracle correction, or post-result tuning is permitted.
validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, and sealed R2 evidence identity match.
Task corpus, surface representation, normal bridge, shuffled bridge, induced classes, and single-step transition semantics are byte-identical to R2.
Exactly 192 heldout programs execute: 64 conjugated-right and 128 long programs.
No heldout program has fewer than three operations and no multi-step program enters training.
Every heldout program uses both operation surface families.
Predictions, not evaluator targets, are fed into the next step for all learners.
Semantic mapping is evaluator-only and occurs after final prediction for scoring.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all twenty-one frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and induced classes materially outperform both controls, but at least one 0.95 multi-step threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but induced multi-step execution does not materially outperform the exact-surface or shuffled-bridge controls.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the full frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any representation, bridge, training-isolation, feed-forward, evaluator-boundary, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific execution on parent, North Star, build, frozen-package, or R2-reuse drift.
After output begins, complete all 192 heldout programs across all three learners unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter alias schedules, program lengths, bridge contexts, transition state, controls, metrics, thresholds, or classification after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No training corpus, representation, bridge, alias schedule, heldout program, learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed under this experiment identifier.

supersedes_unexecuted_prereg.reason: repo-local scheduler inserted another preregistration between R1 preregistration and implementation, violating the direct two-commit qualification boundary
